title: Database cleanup switches running mode to "Disabled Loop" [3.4.*]
symptom: Two AAPS installations switched to "disabled loop" without any reason. Investigation suggests it is related to the DB cleanup process which removes the current "running state" entry making it fallback to "disable loop".
cause: The DB cleanup process removes the current "running state" entry, causing the loop to fallback to "disabled loop".
evidence_quote: Claude investigation shows that it's related to the DB cleanup process which removes the current "running state" entry making it fallback to "disable loop"
